basics.description: Deploys FHIRBridge (portal + API), the Demo app, and their supporting SQL Server Express, Redis, and background Worker into a single Azure Container Apps environment in this subscription.

location.label: Region
location.toolTip: All resources in this deployment are created in this region.

basics.name: namePrefix
basics.label: Deployment name prefix
basics.toolTip: Short name used to build every resource name in this deployment (e.g. <prefix>-app, <prefix>-sqlserver).

constraints.validationMessage: Lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens only, starting with a letter.

elements.name: sqlSaPassword
elements.toolTip: Password for the SQL Server Express container's sa account. Must satisfy SQL Server's complexity policy (8+ chars, upper/lower/digit/symbol).

constraints.validationMessage: At least 8 characters, including upper case, lower case, and a digit.

elements.name: jwtSigningKey
elements.toolTip: FHIRBridge.Api's Authentication:SigningKey (HS256) — used to sign access/refresh tokens. At least 32 random characters; treat it like a secret.

elements.name: redisPassword
elements.toolTip: Password Redis requires to connect (--requirepass) — defense-in-depth on top of network isolation.

elements.name: hapiTerminologyPostgresPassword
elements.toolTip: Password for the Postgres database backing the HAPI terminology server's own schema — internal-only, not the app's own SQL Server database.

elements.name: sqlServerSize
elements.label: SQL Server size
elements.toolTip: SQL Server's first-run setup can need more headroom than steady-state — pick XLarge if it fails to initialize on Large.

elements.name: redisSize
elements.label: Redis size
elements.toolTip: Redis's own cache/queue memory needs — separate from the data it persists to its file share.

elements.name: fhirbridgeAppSize
elements.label: FHIRBridge app size
elements.toolTip: Runs both FHIRBridge.Api and FHIRBridge.Gateway in this one container.

elements.name: workerSize
elements.label: Worker size
elements.toolTip: Background scheduler/pipeline processor — no HTTP endpoint.

elements.name: hapiTerminologySize
elements.label: Terminology server size
elements.toolTip: The HAPI FHIR terminology server itself (Java/Spring — benefits from more memory headroom than the CPU size alone suggests).

elements.name: hapiTerminologyPostgresSize
elements.label: Terminology server database size
elements.toolTip: The Postgres database backing the terminology server's own schema.

elements.name: imageTag
elements.label: Version to install
elements.toolTip: The published version tag to deploy (see the vendor registry's release list for available versions).

options.text:
Optional custom domains need THREE deploys, not two — Azure only assigns each app's domain-verification ID once the app itself already exists, and that ID has to be in DNS before Azure will accept the domain at all. There is no way to know the ID in advance, so it can never be entered on the very first deploy.

If you already entered a domain below on a FIRST-EVER deploy of this name prefix and hit 'InvalidCustomHostNameValidation' / 'a TXT record ... was not found' — that's this exact issue. Fix: clear the domain field(s) below back to blank and redeploy (Phase 0) before continuing to Phase 1.

Phase 0 — Create the app first, with NO custom domain:
• Leave all domain fields below BLANK on your first deploy of a given name prefix
• Deploy — the app is created with its default *.azurecontainerapps.io URL

Phase 1 — Register hostname only:
• From deployment outputs, copy fhirbridgeAppDomainVerificationId / demoAppDomainVerificationId / hapiTerminologyDomainVerificationId (or run containerization/scripts/manage-custom-domain.ps1|.sh -Action Info against the now-existing app)
• At your DNS provider create: CNAME (your domain → the app's *.azurecontainerapps.io FQDN) and TXT (asuid.<your domain> = verification id)
• Wait until DNS has propagated
• NOW enter your domain(s) below, leave "Bind managed SSL certificates now" UNCHECKED, and redeploy — hostnames register successfully this time (no SSL yet)

Phase 2 — Bind free managed SSL:
• Redeploy again with the SAME domain values
• CHECK "Bind managed SSL certificates now"
• Deploy — Azure issues and binds the certificate

Leaving all domain fields blank keeps the default *.azurecontainerapps.io URLs indefinitely — domains are entirely optional. Do not check Bind SSL before Phase 1's hostname is registered, or you will hit RequireCustomHostnameInEnvironment.

Fallback for any of this without a full redeploy: containerization/scripts/manage-custom-domain.ps1|.sh (Info → Add → Bind) against an already-deployed app.

elements.name: fhirbridgeAppCustomDomain
elements.label: FHIRBridge / Segue app custom domain
elements.toolTip: e.g. app.customer.com. Leave blank for the default *.azurecontainerapps.io URL.

elements.name: demoAppCustomDomain
elements.label: Demo app custom domain
elements.toolTip: e.g. demo.customer.com. Leave blank for the default *.azurecontainerapps.io URL.

elements.name: bindCustomDomainCertificates
elements.label: Bind managed SSL certificates now (Phase 2 only)
elements.toolTip: Check ONLY after Phase 1 registered the hostnames and DNS CNAME + asuid TXT have propagated. Unchecked = register hostname only (Phase 1).

elements.name: hapiTerminologyExternalAccess
elements.label: Expose the terminology server externally
elements.toolTip: The HAPI terminology server is internal-only by default (reached only by the FHIRBridge app/Worker, same as SQL Server/Redis). Check this only if it needs to be reached directly from outside — e.g. a separate terminology admin tool, or a third-party integration.

elements.name: hapiTerminologyCustomDomain
elements.label: Terminology server custom domain
elements.toolTip: e.g. terminology.customer.com. Leave blank for the default *.azurecontainerapps.io URL. Setting this automatically exposes the terminology server externally, same two-phase flow as the other custom domains above.

options.text:
This deployment creates resources in the selected resource group only:

• 7 Container Apps — SQL Server Express, Redis, the HAPI Terminology Server + its own Postgres database, FHIRBridge/Segue (Api + Gateway), Demo App, Worker
• 1 Container Apps Environment hosting all 7
• 1 Log Analytics workspace
• 1 Storage Account with Azure File shares (SQL data, Redis data, Terminology server data, Data Protection keys)

Custom domains are optional and require a two-phase deploy (hostname first, then Bind SSL) — see the Custom Domains step. SQL Server, Redis, and the Terminology Server are internal-only by default. Deployment outputs include a resourceManifest used by the cleanup scripts.
Double-check the values on the previous steps, then continue to "Review + create" to see the final parameter summary before anything is actually deployed.
